Brand

Primary mark: Split. Supporting element: Pulse. Decided 2026-11-05. Design canvas: page Brand — final.

Split, the primary mark

The mark is two halves of one circle (r = 34 in a 100-unit box), offset by ±6 like two beats being aligned, with a gap of 4 between them. Together they read as an S.

  • White is the master: what the room hears.
  • Lime is the cue: what's in your headphones.

The mark tells the product's core story, and it holds up down to 16 px.

AssetFile
Mark for dark backgrounds (primary)brand/logo/split-mark.svg
Mark for light backgroundsbrand/logo/split-mark-on-light.svg
Mono white / mono blackbrand/logo/split-mark-mono-white.svg, split-mark-mono-black.svg
App icon master (1024)brand/app-icon/app-icon-master.svg, app-icon-1024.png
Apple app icon (iOS + macOS sizes)platforms/apple/RoutingLab/Assets.xcassets/AppIcon.appiconset
Android adaptive icon (with monochrome layer for themed icons)platforms/android/app/src/main/res/mipmap-anydpi-v26/ic_launcher.xml

Rules

  • Keep a quarter of the mark's height clear on every side.
  • Minimum size: 16 px for the mark alone, 24 px mark height in a lockup.
  • Never rotate, mirror or recolour the halves, never swap white and lime, and never add effects.
  • On light backgrounds use the black + Lime 700 version. On a lime background use the black version.
  • Lockup: the mark plus the lowercase wordmark "soundboard" in Geist SemiBold, tracking −0.035 em. The wordmark cap-height sits at about half the mark's height, with a gap of 0.3× the mark between them.

Pulse, the supporting element

Pulse is a row of waveform bars riding an S-curve, with a tall lime centre bar as the playhead. It means "sound is happening."

Use it for:

  • the launch and splash loader;
  • the analysis progress indicator;
  • the now-playing indicator in the library;
  • patterns on marketing material, empty states and merchandise.

Never use it as a button, and never use it in place of the logo. Animated, the bars breathe in sequence (1.1 s cycle, 90 ms stagger). With Reduce Motion on, Pulse is shown still.

Files: brand/pulse/pulse.svg, brand/pulse/pulse-animated.svg.

Colour

The brand colours are the Obsidian tokens (design/tokens/obsidian.tokens.json). OKLCH is the source of truth. Asset formats that can't hold OKLCH (PNG, Android vector drawables) carry these sRGB conversions:

TokenOKLCHsRGB
neutral-950 (black)oklch(0 0 0)#000000
neutral-50 (white)oklch(0.975 0.006 260)#F4F7FB
lime-500 (Volt)oklch(0.88 0.21 128)#AFF03C
lime-700 (on light)oklch(0.67 0.179 128)#75A800

The user's Appearance accent changes the in-app UI only. The logo and app icon always stay white + Volt lime.

Open item

Clear the name before final release. "Soundboard" is a common word and existing products use it. Run a trademark and App Store / Play Store name search. If the name changes, the Split mark still works as an S for any S-name, or stands alone.

Source: docs/brand.md
